name: Viyash Scientific Limited
summary: Viyash Scientific Limited operates in the veterinary healthcare business in Europe, Asia, and internationally. The company provides finished dosage formulation in therapeutic areas, such as nutrition, pain management, parasite control, antibiotics, and gut health for livestock, poultry, and companion animals. It also offers analytical services; and VET formulation services. The company was formerly known as Sequent Scientific Limited and changed its name to Viyash Scientific Limited in January 2026. The company was incorporated in 1985 and is headquartered in Hyderabad, India. Viyash Scientific Limited operates as a subsidiary of CA Harbor Investments.
